summary: Frontend-only end-to-end verification of all remaining GESOI flows on preview URL after gbhi-style restyle. All 11 flows PASS: cookie consent gating (POST /api/track pageview fires only after Terima), hero CTA join_click event, language toggle EN/ID, join form submission (POST /api/contact 200 + success toast), publications checkout modal + order POST + success toast + cancel-close, news detail page (title/h2/strong/wa.me share/more/back), governance carousel (overflow-x:auto), video + mute + gold quote border, mobile 390 menu + zero horizontal overflow, and CMS regression (login → Editor Website tab → editor-section-pillars → field-pillars-layout SELECT set to 'cards' → editor-save-btn → landing shows pillar-card-01 → editor-reset-btn restores default list layout). Testids differ from spec: main-tab is [data-testid=admin-tab-editor] (not /admin/editor route) and pillar section testid is [data-testid=editor-section-pillars] (not section-pillars) — documented for main agent context.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminEditor is embedded as a tab inside AdminDashboard (/admin) accessed via [data-testid=admin-tab-editor]; there is no standalone /admin/editor route. Review spec referenced /admin/editor — clarify docs.
Editor section navigation uses [data-testid=editor-section-<name>] pattern (e.g., editor-section-pillars) not [section-<name>]; review request wording could be aligned.
Consent-gated analytics correctly throttles pageview to a single POST /api/track after Terima click; join_click event fires immediately on hero CTA. No pre-consent tracking observed.
seed_data_creation: Created during test: TEST_John Doe contact, TEST_Buyer+TEST_Buyer2 orders. ALL CLEANED UP post-run via direct Mongo delete_many on prefix TEST_ (contacts: 34 deleted, orders: 24 deleted — included leftovers from prior iterations). site_content reset to defaults via editor-reset-btn (verified pillar-card-01 disappears from landing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL live. Cookie consent stored in localStorage key 'gesoi_cookie_consent'='accepted'. Analytics endpoint schema: {visitor_id, session_id, type: 'pageview'|'event', name?, path, lang, device, referrer}. Order/contact toast messages: 'Terima kasih! Kami akan segera menghubungi Anda.' and 'Pesanan tercatat! Tim GESOI akan menghubungi Anda untuk pembayaran & akses.'. Interest chip testids: join-interest-{volunteer|partner|donor|founder}. Editor uses admin-tab-editor + editor-section-<name> + field-<section>-<key>.
